rationale: Budgets are based on the full 9,871-result Engine 1.0 export. The monolithic export remains a canonical handoff/debug artifact, but the browser delivery model is bootstrap + one selected race bundle + lazy route/elevation assets.

data_delivery.historical_multi_race_data: load on demand or via purpose-built aggregate; never hydrate all race records at initial app start

frontend_runtime_provisional.note: Critical initial transfer excludes images, map tiles, route/elevation/replay assets and data for non-selected race editions.

regression_policy.frontend_budget_failure: CI failure once build artifacts exist
regression_policy.exception_rule: Budget increases require an explicit documented rationale and before/after measurement.
